calibration_note: Kalshi price vs what actually happened, 422 graded picks: >=95c went +2.9% per leg, 90-95c +4.5%, 40-60c -3.4%, under 40c -6.4%. Favourites hold up; longshots do not. Small sample and self-selected, so it is context, not an edge.
backtest_note: Replayed on the board as it stood 2026-09-12, 26 different tickets went 8/26 against prices that implied 5.7 - so the prices were about right and the spread took 33%. One game, Chattanooga, killed 6 of them, which is the real lesson: these tickets share legs, so one upset takes down most of them.
